body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the validated-referral program for your panel, after my earlier emails on cost-per-sale and the referral-margin math. If clean, provider-confirmed referrals and incrementality are on your roadmap this quarter, I can share the line-by-line referral view and a short holdout read this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way you have the context for when it is useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 Australian English, native register, no transliteration. References original email and earlier stages (cost-per-sale, referral-margin math) in first sentences. Direct close with easy out (releases the prospect if timing is wrong).
